fusions.name: Snap Shut
fusions.desc: Snaps at the target with your weapon for 4 damage, making it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds, with a 20% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Round-Up
fusions.desc: Strikes every enemy within 3 tiles for 12 damage and leaves each [Stunned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Pen Them In
fusions.desc: Closes a pen 6 tiles across ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward. Anything it catches moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Circle
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 20% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
